offering_description.value: Morningstar sells investment data, research, and analytics to financial institutions, advisers, and individual investors. It collects and analyzes public and private market data and delivers it through software, data feeds, ratings, and indexes. It also provides investment management and retirement account services.

primary_products.value: fund and securities data and research; private market databases; credit and sustainability ratings; portfolio analytics software; market indexes

primary_services.value: issuer credit rating and surveillance; portfolio management and model portfolios; managed retirement accounts; retirement investment advice

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, financial advisers, banks, private market investors, retirement plan providers, and debt issuers; B2C: individual investors and workplace retirement plan participants; B2G: public libraries that subscribe to investment research

end_markets.value: asset and wealth management; private capital markets; banking and debt capital markets; workplace retirement; personal investing

revenue_model.value: subscription: access to research, investment databases, and analytics software; service fees: initial credit ratings and ongoing surveillance for debt issuers; licensing or royalties: rights to distribute data and ratings or use indexes in investment products; commissions or management fees: asset based fees for managed portfolios and retirement accounts
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; licensing or royalties; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: turns market and investment data into research and analytics tools for investors and financial firms; service provider: analyzes issuer and investment data to provide ratings, benchmarks, and advice to financial firms and investors; financial intermediary: uses client objectives and risk profiles to manage investment portfolios for advisers and retirement savers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: investment data and analytics, private market intelligence, credit and sustainability ratings, indexes, wealth management, and retirement services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales teams serving financial firms, debt issuers, and retirement plan providers; online: self-service subscriptions for individual investors and web platforms for professional users; partners / resellers: financial advisers, retirement recordkeepers, investment platforms, and third-party data distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Credit rating and investment advisory subsidiaries face SEC registration and oversight, plus comparable local rules abroad.
